no LOC / RA

active as usual

Primary survey:
No castotrophic haemorrhage

- No open wounds seen

entries.title: Discharge advice
entries.text:
DISCHARGE
Caregiver counselled regarding working diagnosis, home care and red flags.
Return immediately for breathing difficulty, poor intake, reduced urine, persistent lethargy, seizure or any worsening concern.
Follow-up:
Caregiver verbalised understanding and agrees with plan.
